chain_A.reference: UniProt Q9NZQ7 (human PD-L1, 290 aa), fetched with sequence-toolkit fetch-uniprot

n_terminal.note: initiator methionine, absent from the mature UniProt sequence

c_terminal.note: not present at reference positions 133-134 (reference has AP); non-native two-residue appendage

chain_A.interpretation: Chain A equals UniProt Q9NZQ7 residues 18-132 (the C-terminal alanine of the 18-residue signal peptide plus the mature IgV domain 19-132), preceded by an artificial initiator Met and followed by a non-native LE. The MMetrics record itself returned no UniProt annotation for chain A (annotations.uniprot = []), so the PD-L1 assignment is an external sequence check, not a native MMetrics call.
chain_A.reference_region_note: Q9NZQ7 signal peptide is annotated 1-18; the mature chain begins at F19. Chain A therefore also carries the signal-peptide-terminal A18.

chain_B.interpretation: The VHH heavy chain is identical (100%, 128/128) to PDB 5JDS chain B, i.e. the blast top hit is the same nanobody sequence. It is a sequence-level self-hit, not an independent homologue. Per the case instruction, 5JDS was not downloaded, superimposed or otherwise used as a reference structure.

structure_prediction: not re-run; the only structure in this case is the imported MMFold_1.cif
